name: Milky Ways

features.name: Fusion Spins
features.description: Winning symbols lock for a respin.

review:
Milky Ways is a bright 5x3 space slot with a Medium volatility rating. Solar Wilds reveal x1 to x3 multipliers that multiply together, so two or three in one win can add up quickly.

Three scatters trigger Milky Ways Spins fairly often, expanding the grid from 5x3 to 5x5 for more ways. Any win in the bonus starts Fusion Spins, which lock winning symbols and respin. The cap is 5,664x, with a 33% hit rate. Approachable and fun.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
